snippet.title: KH Melon Mix v0.5.8 Update - Kingdom Hearts Re:Coded
snippet.description:
Some of you may already know about our project.

For those who don't know, it's a modified version of melonDS (Nintendo DS emulator) aimed at turning Days and Re:Coded into proper "PC game" experiences, which means better controls, better graphics, and a single screen instead of two.

We have made many advancements in Days since that video, but that video is focused on Re:Coded, which is now almost on par with Days.

Note: While cutscene replacement works, it's still a WIP for Re:Coded, so we currently still don't recommend using it.

Download link:
https://github.com/vitor251093/KHMelonMix/releases/latest
